description: This Java source file defines a Spring @Configuration class 'UserAdministrationConfiguration' that provides bean definitions for user administration services in the Fineract project, including services for user reading/writing, permission, role, and password policy management.

classes.name: UserAdministrationConfiguration
classes.description: A Spring configuration class providing bean definitions for user administration services in the Fineract project.

methods.name: appUserReadPlatformService
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of AppUserReadPlatformService, configured with dependencies such as security context, JDBC template, and related services, for reading user data.

methods.name: appUserWritePlatformService

methods.name: passwordPreferencesWritePlatformService

methods.name: permissionReadPlatformService

methods.name: permissionWritePlatformService
methods.description: Provides functionality to write permission data, utilizing security context and permission repositories.
